target_customer: Developers and AI coding platforms (for example Natively) whose coding agents need a backend and cloud deployment
problem: Coding agents can write code but need infrastructure, databases, auth and deployment that they can provision themselves.
business_model: Usage-based cloud platform and backend as a service for coding agents
product_category: Cloud platform and backend infrastructure for AI coding agents

founders.name: Fabian Lindfors
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. A directory says he and Radjavi are high school classmates, unverified.

founders.name: Iman Radjavi
education: MSc in Computer Science (school not stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: four years at startups building software for energy grids and healthcare data.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs a platform that provisions isolated environments, databases (Neon says over 10,000 databases managed), auth, payments and deploys from an agent via MCP, with scale to zero.

defensibility.rationale: Backend platforms for agents are being built by Supabase, Appwrite, InsForge, Base44 and others, and the pieces rest on third-party infrastructure like Neon. Lock-in comes only from hosted apps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents and several startups added agent oriented backends and MCP docs through 2025 and 2026, per vendor pages. No acquisition of Specific found.

market_need_then: Vibe coding tools defaulted to Supabase for backends in 2025 and agent builders needed backend provisioning. Natively is named as a target customer on the YC page and a January 2026 partnership with Natively is reported by a directory.

branding.domain_note: Uses specific.dev; not the .com. Another YC company in the same batch is called Specific Labs (withspecific.com).

identity.voice_and_tone: Command line first developer voice (specific dev, specific deploy).

branding.brand_signature: CLI commands specific dev and specific deploy
branding.community_and_virality: A Neon engineering blog post is about how Specific provisions thousands of databases; otherwise little found.

brand_strength.rationale: The generic word Specific is hard to search for and shares its name with many unrelated firms and a same batch YC company, which search results kept confusing.

outcome_analysis: Specific is an active two person Stockholm company from YC Fall 2025 that offers a cloud platform driven by coding agents. It shows early usage through Neon (over 10,000 databases) and a Natively partnership, but no priced round is public. Crowded agent backend competition and a generic name are the main risks, and the outcome is still open.
notes: The company website specific.dev and its about page could not be fetched because the fetch safety check was rate limited; details come from the YC page and search snippets. Funding conflicts across aggregators (EveryDev 130K seed on 2025-09-01; VCBacked and Caplight 500K pre-seed 2025-12 with an estimated 1.79M valuation from Caplight); all unverified so no round recorded.
